title: Fix the five failing NavigationTest tests on the managed device
findings_note: S55 ran `./gradlew pixel6api34DebugAndroidTest` on `aosp-atd`: 29 tests, 5 failures, all in `NavigationTest`.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** adding new instrumented tests, changing the `instrumented` CI job or the `pixel6api34` device from S55, and running on more than one API level.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
- S55's `instrumented` CI job runs the `androidTest` suite on a Gradle Managed Device (`pixel6api34`, `aosp-atd`). It stays red until that suite passes.
- The run before S15 was 29 tests and 5 `NavigationTest` failures. S15 changed the three assertion tests on main. The two `Espresso.pressBack` failures were not part of that change.
- Re-run the current suite before editing. The suite is larger than 29 tests after S15.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `app/src/androidTest/java/com/squalor/consecutor/NavigationTest.kt`
- `app/src/main/java/com/squalor/consecutor/ui/EntryEditorDialog.kt`, `ui/TrackerDetailScreen.kt`, `MainScreen.kt` (only if a fix has to change them)

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
Instrumented tests in `NavigationTest` on `pixel6api34` (`aosp-atd`). The run before S15 was 29 tests and 5 failures:

- `editingTrackerNameSurvivesRecreation`
- `entryFieldsSurviveRecreation`
- `selectedTrackerSurvivesRecreation`
- `backFromDetailReturnsToDashboard`
- `backFromSettingsReturnsToDashboard`

S15 (`f374778`) changed the first three on main: `performTextReplacement` of the full field value, and `onAllNodesWithText` for the duplicate detail title. It did not change the two `Espresso.pressBack` tests. It also added `backFromArchivedReturnsToDashboard`, which uses `pressBack` and passed on a normal API 34 emulator, not on `aosp-atd`. The merged suite is larger than 29 tests. Re-run before editing.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Re-run `./gradlew pixel6api34DebugAndroidTest` on current main with `systemImageSource` `aosp-atd`.
2. Fix whatever still fails. The two `pressBack` tests (`backFromDetailReturnsToDashboard`, `backFromSettingsReturnsToDashboard`) are the failures S15 did not change. Do not redo S15's text-replacement edits if those tests already pass.
3. Do not change `systemImageSource` in `app/build.gradle`. Do not change the `instrumented` CI job or the `pixel6api34` device.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `./gradlew pixel6api34DebugAndroidTest` passes on the current suite, 0 failures.
- The `instrumented` job on GitHub is green (owner pushes).
